title: Pro Shop Store Credit: birthday-bonus and corporate-wellness discount terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's occasion-bonus and cross-program discount facet across every tier: the bonus credit granted around the member's birthday, the maximum number of birthday bonuses granted per year, and the discount available when this account is bundled with an active corporate wellness enrollment.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Birthday bonus credit | Birthday bonuses allowed per year | Discount when bundled with an active corporate wellness enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | 5.00 USD | 1 | 0 percent |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | 10.00 USD | 1 | 0 percent |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | 15.00 USD | 1 | 5 percent |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | 25.00 USD | 1 | 10 percent |
| Auto-Reload Standard | 10.00 USD | 1 | 0 percent |
| Auto-Reload Premium | 20.00 USD | 1 | 5 percent |

## Points of reference
- Every tier of this product limits the birthday bonus to one grant per year; the birthday bonus credit amount itself scales with the tier.
- The discount available when bundled with an active corporate wellness enrollment is zero on the Starter Credit $50 Tier, Standard Credit $100 Tier and Auto-Reload Standard, and positive on the remaining three tiers.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tier grants the largest birthday bonus credit?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier, at 25.00 USD.
**Which tiers currently offer no discount for bundling with an active corporate wellness enrollment?** The Starter Credit $50 Tier, the Standard Credit $100 Tier, and Auto-Reload Standard.
